review.imagery: Sixteen distinct high-resolution official gallery renders were visually reviewed. The duplicate living-room image is excluded. Exterior labels distinguish the four-, five- and six-bedroom types. Shared interior scenes retain project scope. Card and hero use the four-bedroom frontage. No dated construction photography was established and no card badges are present.
review.floorPlans: All six original Wasl sheets are available, covering ground, first and roof levels for each villa type. The displayed total covers the whole home once. The six-bedroom floor components sum to 9,178.38 sq ft, while the printed total is 9,178.39 sq ft. The published total is retained. Confirm the selected plot and final included specifications with Wasl. All six whole sheets and their visible numerical panels were inspected. The final printed panels take precedence over hidden stale engineering text. Whole original pages, branding, level labels and area tables remain intact. Overlapping brochure diagrams are excluded from duplicate selectable layouts.
review.location: The brochure’s Ashwood masterplan on physical page 7 was visually reviewed, including the marked main entrance. Current primary-page journey estimates retain their car scope. Both Wasl Pinewood and Ashwood embeds publish the same DMS reference 25°01'13.6"N 55°10'40.4"E, so the pin is explicitly scoped as shared JGE vicinity. Both source hashes and coordinate arithmetic are saved.
review.provenance: The official HTML, all three original two-page plan PDFs and Property Finder hosted branded brochure are cached with hashes and ordinary-GET receipts. Current gallery assets retain original bytes, dimensions and source URLs. Original text research, source qualifications and protected identities are preserved.

unavailable: A verified villa-specific visitor entrance and dated construction photographs were not established. Source arithmetic and portal unit-metadata conflicts remain qualified.
